classified.result: Official Germany direct pricing on Plenitude-owned points is safely representable for unambiguous DC power classes: below 75 kW 0.50 EUR/kWh and above 75 kW 0.65 EUR/kWh. Blocking starts 60 minutes after charge end at 0.20 EUR/min below 75 kW and 0.30 EUR/min above 75 kW. The official page overlaps at exactly 75 kW (Fast 'up to 75 kW' versus Fast+/Ultra Fast '>=75 kW', while blocking wording says >75 kW), and the frozen canonical snapshot contains 75 kW points; those remain fail-closed. Current public records also suggest DE*BEC -> DE*PLN prefix migration, but the frozen canonical IDs are not rewritten without primary mapping.

The 227 canonical DE*MDS EVSEs span many distinct physical operators, so DE*MDS is treated as a shared technical namespace rather than a physical-CPO tariff scope. Public station/EVSE observations vary materially and AFIR/Mobilithek/chargecloud-style exact station data are the safe path. No prefix-wide operator or tariff is emitted; unresolved EVSEs remain visible and unpriced.

All 174 canonical DE*SMC EVSEs resolve to smopi, but current station-level prices demonstrably vary (public-data examples include 0.44 and 0.79 EUR/kWh AC; a separate DC discovery example is 1.19 EUR/kWh). No universal prefix tariff is inferred. Exact AFIR/Mobilithek/DATEX II station prices are accepted only at their verified EVSE scope; unknown points stay unpriced.
